responsibility: Provides rustc’s incremental dependency-tracking subsystem: it defines the dep-node identity model and persisted work-product IDs, the `DepContext`/`Deps` interface that connects query execution to dependency recording and cache loading, the live per-session dependency graph that interns nodes, records task edges, tracks red/green state and work products, the serialized graph format used to encode and reload prior compilation state, inspectable query views over recorded nodes and edges, and debug-only filtering utilities for examining dep-graph structure.
